_comment: Canonical Aether event registry — DO NOT manually edit. Source of truth for packages/shared/events.ts and generated_registry.py. Edit here, then run: python scripts/generate_contracts.py

events.description: Page/screen view from aether.pageView() + SPA hooks
Session liveness heartbeat from session manager
Journey paused by user or system
Consent state change — always allowed regardless of consent state
Agent delegated task to another agent
Agent handed off to another system
Reward eligibility action queued — emitted by Aether, not the tenant
Agent OTP detected (structural metadata only, not the OTP value)
x402 resource request observed from external perspective
Content item was displayed to the user
Recommendation was displayed to the user
Offer was presented to the user
Product feature was exposed to the user
Search result was shown to the user
Advertisement was displayed to the user
System decision presented to or observed by user
User or agent achieved a defined goal
User or agent failed to achieve a goal
Human overrode an agent or system recommendation
Member invited to organization or workspace
Member removed from organization or workspace
Service account created (reference only, not credentials)
API key created (key ID reference only)
Dunning process started for failed payment
Dead click observed (DOM-level, web only auto-capture)
Rage click observed (multiple rapid clicks, web only auto-capture)
Form interaction started (structural metadata only — no values)
Form field interaction (field type and metadata only — no entered values)
Form validation failed (category and count, not values)
Search query reformulated (hash/category, not raw query)
User backtracked to a previous step
API request observed from server-side (no request/response body)
Agent inference or tool cost observed
Human override of agent action observed
Transaction affected by chain reorg observed
Email accepted by provider queue (lifecycle state)
Email handed to recipient MTA by provider
Email delivery deferred by recipient MTA
Email dropped by provider before send
Inbound human reply to a sent email
Send suppressed by provider suppression list
Message received (structural metadata only — no content)
Message sent (structural metadata only — no content)
Credit signal observed — requires explicit credit opt-in
Credit account state observed — requires explicit credit opt-in
Credit decision observed — requires explicit credit opt-in. Host-observed only; Aether does not make credit decisions.
Location observation — requires explicit location opt-in
Geofence entry/exit — requires explicit location opt-in
